name: PT Pakuan Tbk
summary: PT Pakuan Tbk develops residential and commercial projects in Indonesia. It operates through Sale of Properties and Rental of Properties segments. The company is also involved in the purchasing, operating, renting, and selling of real estate; and trading, transportation, and animal husbandry activities. In addition, it engages in the construction of a housing project and commercial area under the Shila at Sawangan brand. The company was founded in 1971 and is based in Depok, Indonesia.
